texts.facts: This writ petition is filed seeking for a direction to release Black Matpe imported as per Ext. P1 to the petitioner after giving an opportunity for completing the cleaning as permitted under Exts. P2, P6, P9 and P10 and later conducting a fresh sampling and analysis/testing without any delay. 2. While importing the aforesaid commodity, the 1st respondent found that the same was not in accordance with the standard specified under the Food Safety and Standards Act and the Rules framed thereunder. Thereafter, on the request of the petitioner, they were permitted to clean the commodity.
